basic_info.description: Prime Northwest Corner unit with Bay & Golden Gate Bridge Views! This nicely updated building is located across from Lafayette Park and just steps away from the boutiques and cafes of Fillmore Street. Remodeled in 2025, this 2BR 2BA condominium features new flooring, a new kitchen and two tastefully renovated bathrooms. Both bedrooms offer views of the Golden Gate Bridge along with access to a wonderful walkout terrace. Designed for both relaxation and entertaining, the open floor plan seamlessly connects indoor and outdoor living spaces. This is a full-service building with exceptional amenities, including a 24-hour doorman, elevators, on-site management, fitness center, laundry facilities, and a spectacular Clubroom on the 16th floor,  Earthquake insurance included. One car parking with EV charging station & storage.
